A bold wrapper holding only a line break still separates the words on either side

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<b>Alpha</b><b><br></b><b>Beta</b>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
